summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) to register 150M Series A Depositary Shares, each representing a 1/20th interest in a share of mandatory convertible preferred stock with a $1,000 liquidation preference. The offering is a capital raise via mandatory convertible preferred shares that automatically convert into Class A common stock by May 2029. Dividends are cumulative at an annual rate to be set, payable in cash or stock. The shares are not publicly traded before but will list on Nasdaq. This is a routine equity-linked offering, not a special situation. No special situation category applies.
